status_semantics.LIVE_SCREENING: Operational screening intelligence; not a deterministic engineering, legal or actuarial conclusion.
status_semantics.VALIDATION_PROGRAM: Backend or partial capability exists and is being validated before stronger claims.
status_semantics.INTEGRATION_REQUIRED: BridgePoint-side contract/design exists but requires an external provider, credential or approval.
status_semantics.BUILDING: Architecture exists but is not presented as production-ready.

capability_families.purpose: Evidence-linked property identity, signals, provenance and prioritization.
Weather, field evidence, authorized IoT/BAS observations and versioned property-state updates.
capability_families.important_limit: Live sensor state exists only where an authorized device/building integration is connected.

capability_families.purpose: Versioned property/building twins upgraded as imagery, LiDAR, BIM, drone, blueprint and sensor evidence arrives.
capability_families.important_limit: A partial twin is not represented as an exact replica without sufficient validated source precision.

capability_families.purpose: Canonical claim timelines, evidence events, estimate comparisons and controlled export mappings.
Evidence-backed estimate scope/quantity/price variance detection and human-review supplement-support assembly.
capability_families.important_limit: A variance is not proof of coverage owed or wrongful underpayment; submission remains subject to human review.

capability_families.purpose: Property and portfolio screening for weather, peril and longer-horizon climate vulnerability.
capability_families.important_limit: Screening outputs are not deterministic actuarial or engineering conclusions.

capability_families.purpose: Quiet-weather preventive inspection, maintenance prioritization, renewal readiness and property-health workflows.
Governed validation programs for experimental sensing and deeper physical-property intelligence.
capability_families.important_limit: Experimental modalities remain explicitly validation-stage until calibration and professional-confirmation gates are met.
